mapper.select: SELECT id FROM blog_tag WHERE name = #{name} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT t.name FROM blog_post_tag pt JOIN blog_tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE pt.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY t.name

SELECT t.name AS name, COUNT(1) AS postCount FROM blog_tag t JOIN blog_post_tag pt ON pt.tag_id = t.id JOIN blog_post p ON p.id = pt.post_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE p.blog_id = #{blogId} GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY postCount DESC
